<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex048052026-11-2405-29-47" status="reviewed">
                  <milestone n="Colophon (51b1-51b4)" unit="section"/>
                  <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4821">gzhi lam 'bras bu gsal byed pa'i
               <lb n="51b2"/> rin po che</rs> 'di <rs type="place" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4411">snar thang</rs> gi | dge 'dun tshogs kyi <expan>dbus su</expan> 'debs || dge des kun mkhyen thob par shog || 

              <lg><l> <note type="gloss">gdams °°</note>rnam grol don gnyer skyes bu gang || </l>
               <l>blo yi mgul na <lb n="51b3"/> 'dis rgyan pa || </l>
               <l>gser ri'i dbus na ri rab ltar ||</l> 
               <l>mkhas pa'i dbus na mdzes par 'gyur || </l></lg>
               <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4821">gzhi lam 'bras bu gsal bar byed pa rin po tshe gser phreng</rs> zhes bya ba <lb n="51b4"/> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3977">dge slong nam mkha' grags</rs> kyis bsdebs pa'o || dge'o || rang gzhan gyi ma rig pa sel bar gyur cig ||
               <milestone n="Annotations" unit="section"/>
               <milestone n="1. Revision" unit="section"/>
               1 zhus dag
               <milestone n="2. Verse" unit="section"/>
               <lg><l><lb n="51b5"/> bstan bcos shes bya'i sgron ma 'di |</l> 
               <l>su yid lag thogs dang ba'i 'phel |</l> 
               <l>kun la 'jug pa'i don gyi phyir |</l> 
               <l>mkhas pa rnams kyi 'bral pa srungs ||</l></lg></seg></TEI>
